cases.sentence: Послушайте меня, стремящиеся к ___, и ищущие Господа.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to/toward) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Взгляните на скалу, из которой вы вытесаны, и на ___, из которой вы извлечены.
cases.explain: The preposition на (onto) governs the accusative case when indicating direction.

cases.sentence: Взгляните на ___ вашего отца и на Сару, родившую вас.
cases.explain: The preposition на (to) in this context governs the genitive case with the meaning 'to, toward'.

cases.sentence: От меня выйдет ___, мое правосудие станет светом для народов.
cases.explain: Закон is the grammatical subject of the verb выйдет (will go out), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Мое избавление близится быстро, спасение мое уже в пути. Своей рукой я установлю ___ среди народов.
cases.explain: Правосудие is the direct object of the transitive verb установлю (I will establish), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Поднимите взгляд к ___, и взгляните на землю внизу.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governing a dative case indicates the direction of looking upward.

cases.sentence: Но мое спасение будет вечным, избавление мое никогда не кончится. Слушайте меня, знающие ____, народ, у которого в сердце мой закон.
cases.explain: The verb знающие (knowing) takes the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Я, Господь, твой Бог, возмущающий море так, что волны его ревут. Я вложил мои слова в уста твои и прикрыл тебя тенью моей руки. Я простер небеса, положил основание ___, и сказал Сиону, ты мой народ.
cases.explain: The noun phrase 'основание земли' (foundation of the earth) requires the genitive case after the noun основание.

reading.ru: Послушайте меня, стремящиеся к правде и ищущие Господа.
reading.question: Who is being called to listen in this verse?
options: Those who follow righteousness and seek the Lord
reading.correct: Those who follow righteousness and seek the Lord
reading.explain: The text explicitly says 'Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness, you who seek Yahweh.'

reading.ru: Взгляните на Авраама вашего отца и на Сару, родившую вас.
reading.question: Who are the people being referred to as examples of God's blessing?
reading.explain: The passage says 'Look to Abraham your father, and to Sarah who bore you.'

reading.ru: Так же Господь непременно утешит Сион, утешит он все его развалины.
reading.question: What does the Lord promise to do for Zion?
options: Comfort Zion and all its ruins
reading.correct: Comfort Zion and all its ruins
reading.explain: The text states 'the Lord will comfort Zion. He will comfort all her waste places.'

reading.ru: От меня выйдет закон, мое правосудие станет светом для народов.
reading.question: What role will the Lord's law and justice have among the nations?
options: They will be a light to the nations
They will be rejected by all peoples
They will bring darkness and confusion
They will exist only in Israel
reading.correct: They will be a light to the nations
reading.explain: The passage says 'a law will go out from me, and I will establish my justice for a light to the peoples.'

reading.ru: Как небо выше земли, так мои пути выше ваших путей, и мои мысли выше ваших мыслей.
reading.question: In this verse, what comparison is made between God's thoughts and human thoughts?
options: God's thoughts are as much higher than human thoughts as heaven is higher than earth
God's thoughts are the same as human thoughts
God's thoughts are lower than human thoughts
God has no thoughts at all
reading.correct: God's thoughts are as much higher than human thoughts as heaven is higher than earth
reading.explain: The text directly compares: 'As the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.'

reading.ru: Поднимись, поднимись, облекись силой мышца Господня, поднимись, как в минувшие дни, как в поколения древности.
reading.question: What is the Lord calling people to do, and what is he compared to in this passage?
options: Rise and put on strength; the Lord's arm is compared to power of past generations
Sleep and rest peacefully in the night
Forget the past and ignore history
reading.correct: Rise and put on strength; the Lord's arm is compared to power of past generations
reading.explain: The passage says 'Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times.'
